parsing.notes: Authoritative Bangladeshi registrar (RJSC). The eservices portal offers a free company name search (name + registration number), but particulars/documents are pay-per-use; no open bulk or free API. From this environment the main site had a TLS intermediate-certificate issue and eservices.roc.gov.bd did not resolve. Do NOT bypass payment. Key = RJSC registration number. registration_date is the true incorporation date. Directors are personal data (paid documents) — redact. Field model from public knowledge; no values captured. Confirm whether RJSC offers an official data-sharing channel.

live_test_plan.smoke: Not runnable openly (documents paid; cert issue). Use the free name search to confirm name + number.
live_test_plan.full: Blocked on payment — requires an RJSC paid/eservices path or an official data arrangement; redact personal data.

blockers: No open bulk file or free API; eservices host did not resolve; TLS cert issue
